_motion_note: motion is 'kenburns' (slow zoom on each still, seconds per shot) or 'video' (real animation from a local image-to-video model, minutes per shot). Try video on one episode with --motion video before switching the default. Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B is chosen because it fits a 16 GB Mac; the LTX 22B models do not. If a run runs out of memory, lower videoMaxFrames to 49 or videoWidth/videoHeight to 448/768.
_lora_note: Once you have ~20 good stills of the pair, train a LoRA in Draw Things (Settings → LoRA training, about 20 minutes on an M-series Mac) and put its name in 'lora' above. That is what takes consistency from good to locked.
_pinned: Model, size and seed are pinned so a re-run reproduces the same images. Steps and guidance are left to the model's recommended settings (FLUX.2 klein is distilled and wants few steps and low guidance); add "steps" or "guidance" here only to override them deliberately.
_look_note: Pip is a little taller and sturdier; Willow is petite with pink accents (bow, blossoms, blush, heart patch, eyelashes) so the two read as boy and girl at a glance, even on a small phone screen.
designChange: Both koalas stand side by side on the ground, full bodies head to feet, facing the camera. Willow is almost as tall as Pip: about 90% of his height, the top of her head level with Pip's eyes. Keep their faces, fur colours, Pip's mustard scarf, Willow's pink blossoms behind her left ear and pink heart patch exactly the same. No bow.
_world_note: Koalas live in hot Australia: no rain, frost or snow. Golden light, red earth, gum trees, heat haze.
